limitations: Scope: the complete deposit (5 of 5 raw files) is annotated; the companion puromycin QuaNCAT experiment is a separate deposit (PXD062045) and is not part of this SDRF.

Deposited experiment names are WT-H_1/2/3, WT-L_1, WT-L_3 while Supplementary Table 2A names the reverse mixes sgControl-L_1 and sgControl-L_2; the per-protein ratio match in orientation.txt identifies sgControl-L_2 with WT-L_3. No WT-L_2 raw file is deposited and the paper reports n = 5, so none appears to be missing.
Which sgMETTL13 guide (sgMETTL13-1 or -2) was used for the QuaNCAT cultures is not stated; the genetic modification is written without a guide sequence.
comment[precursor mass tolerance] 7 ppm comes from the paper text only; MaxQuant 1.5.5.1 parameters.txt does not record it and no mqpar.xml was deposited.

Biological replicate numbering assumes each of the 5 mixes used independently cultured cell populations, as the paper's 'n = 5 independent experiments' states; within a mix the sgControl and sgMETTL13 cultures carry the same experiment number in their respective groups.
characteristics[cell type], passage number and sample storage temperature are not stated in any source (not available).
